claims.evidence: The witness reports a V6 badge and specific body styling; the 2024 Tacoma (N400) only uses 4-cylinder engines and has a different tailgate design.
Photo 2 shows a 'V6' badge on the right side of the tailgate.
The witness did not report any TRD decals or 4x4 badging on the exterior.
No shipping documents or customs papers are shown to confirm its status.
The interior is not shown in the report.
The roof of the vehicle is not visible in the provided observations.
No documentation regarding Nigerian customs duties was provided.

risks.proof: A video clip of the engine starting and idling with the dashboard visible.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-runner requiring a full engine or electrical overhaul.

risks.risk: The vehicle is a salvage/auction unit with hidden damage.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the VIN plate and a corresponding history report.
risks.if_unproven: as a salvage-title vehicle with major accident history.

risks.proof: Photos of the chassis and undercarriage.

proof_requests: Photo of the VIN plate on the driver's side door jamb.
Video of the engine running and the instrument cluster.
Photos of the interior and the roof to confirm features.
Clear photos of the Nigerian Customs 'Single Goods Declaration' (SGD) form.
response.reason: The seller claims the vehicle is a 2024 model with a V6 engine, which is a configuration that does not exist. Furthermore, the seller omits the 'No Start' marking clearly visible on the glass, indicating a deceptive description of a salvage vehicle.
